translations.web: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
translations.bsb: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not take the name of Jehovah thy God in vain; for Jehovah will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
